messages.content: Who are you?
Hi, I’m Amy! Your personal assistant.
Introduce yourself.
Hello! I'm Amy, here to help you with anything you need.
What is your name?
My name is Amy.
What is Ease Margin?

Ease Margin is a cloud-based AI enabled software built specifically for MSME manufacturers to manage sales, purchase, inventory, production, and reports from a single platform with web and mobile access.
Who should use Ease Margin?
Ease Margin is ideal for small and medium manufacturing businesses currently using registers, Excel, or disconnected systems.
What problem does Ease Margin solve?
Ease Margin eliminates manual work, data duplication, and operational confusion by providing a single integrated ERP for manufacturing operations.
What is the vision of Ease Margin?
The vision of Ease Margin is to become the default ERP platform for MSME manufacturers in India.
Is Ease Margin cloud-based?
Yes, Ease Margin is a fully cloud-based ERP accessible from web browsers and mobile devices.
What modules are available in Ease Margin?
Ease Margin includes Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Production, Material Planning, Service management, Accounting Integration, Reports, and a Mobile App.
What sales documents are supported?
Ease Margin supports Sales lead, Sales Quotation, Sales Order, Proforma Invoice, Delivery Challan, Invoice, Debit Note, and Credit Note.
Is a Sales Order a confirmation?
Yes, in Ease Margin, a Sales Order is treated as a confirmation of sale.
Can invoice prices be changed?
Yes, Ease Margin allows flexible invoice pricing while maintaining FIFO-based stock cost calculations.
What purchase documents are supported?
Ease Margin supports Purchase Orders, Purchase Invoices, GRN, Quality Report, and Purchase Returns.
Does Ease Margin support Purchase Orders?
Yes, Purchase Orders can be created, shared, and tracked until material receipt.
How does inventory management work?
Ease Margin provides real-time inventory tracking across multiple stores with FIFO-based stock reduction and complete stock history.
Does Ease Margin follow FIFO?
Yes, Ease Margin reduces inventory using FIFO and displays FIFO cost while creating invoices.
Can I manage multiple stores?
Yes, Ease Margin supports multiple stores and godowns with real-time visibility.
What are automated stock alerts?
Ease Margin sends alerts for stock-outs, overstocking, production delays, and document creation.
What is material rejection tracking?
Rejected material during purchase or production is tracked in a separate rejection store.
Can I view item-wise stock history?
Yes, each item has a complete stock history showing inward, outward, and balance quantities.
Can I add custom item fields?
Yes, custom fields such as length, width, thickness, grade, or other manufacturing attributes can be added.
Are custom fields shown in documents?
Yes, custom fields can be displayed in sales, purchase, and production documents.
Does Ease Margin support production tracking?
Yes, Ease Margin tracks raw material consumption and finished goods production.
Is production linked with inventory?
Yes, raw materials reduce automatically and finished goods increase after production entry.
Does Ease Margin integrate with accounting software?
Yes, Ease Margin integrates with accounting software for seamless financial reporting.
Do users need accounting knowledge?
No, Ease Margin is designed so non-accounting users can easily operate the system.
What reports are available?
Ease Margin provides sales, purchase, inventory valuation, FIFO cost, item and document level reports, margin reports and many more.
Can Ease Margin track profitability?
Yes, Ease Margin links FIFO cost with sales price to calculate margins.
Is a mobile app available?
Yes, Ease Margin offers a mobile app for managing operations on the go.
What can users do on the mobile app?
Users can create documents, view reports, track inventory, production and monitor business performance.
How long does implementation take?
Ease Margin implementation typically takes 2 weeks.
How many implementation sessions are required?
Implementation includes 7 to 10 structured sessions of 1 hour each along with call support.
Does Ease Margin help with data migration?
Yes, Ease Margin assists in migrating data from Excel or legacy systems.
What is the pricing of Ease Margin?
Ease Margin pricing starts at ₹499 per user per month.
Is Ease Margin affordable for MSMEs?
Yes, Ease Margin offers high ROI by reducing errors, saving time, and improving margins.
How is Ease Margin better than Excel?
Excel is manual and error-prone, while Ease Margin offers automation, real-time data, and integrated workflows.
How is Ease Margin different from Tally?
Tally focuses on accounting, while Ease Margin focuses on complete manufacturing operations.
Is Ease Margin customizable?
Yes, Ease Margin adapts to different manufacturing workflows using custom fields and flexible processes.
Is data secure in Ease Margin?
Yes, Ease Margin uses secure cloud infrastructure with access control and regular backups.
What is the future roadmap of Ease Margin?
Ease Margin is expanding automation, analytics, and mobile-first capabilities.
Why do most MSME manufacturers struggle with ERP adoption?
Most MSME manufacturers struggle because traditional ERPs are complex, expensive, and designed for large enterprises, not factory floor realities.
What problems do registers and Excel cause in manufacturing?
Registers and Excel lead to data mismatch, delayed decisions, stock errors, no real-time visibility, and dependency on a single person.
Why is real-time inventory critical for manufacturers?
Real-time inventory prevents stock-outs, excess purchases, production delays, and incorrect pricing decisions.
Why is FIFO important in Ease Margin?
FIFO ensures accurate costing by consuming the oldest stock first, giving manufacturers correct margin visibility.
Can users see FIFO cost before invoicing?
Yes, Ease Margin displays FIFO cost while setting invoice prices, helping users make informed pricing decisions.
What happens if invoice price is changed?
Invoice prices can be changed without breaking FIFO logic, ensuring correct stock cost and margin calculation.
How does Ease Margin help improve margins?
By linking FIFO cost, inventory, and sales pricing, Ease Margin gives manufacturers clear margin visibility.
Why does Ease Margin implementation take 2 weeks?
Implementation includes understanding processes, data migration, user training, accounting integration, and stabilization.
What happens in implementation sessions?
Sessions cover masters setup, inventory logic, document flows, production entries, reporting, and real use-case training.
What makes Ease Margin implementation successful?
Clear process mapping, disciplined data entry, user training, and continuous support ensure success.
Is Ease Margin suitable for very small factories?
Yes, Ease Margin is designed to scale from small factories to growing manufacturing businesses.
What if my manufacturing process is unique?
Ease Margin adapts to unique processes using custom fields and flexible workflows.
Why should I trust Ease Margin?
The team has completed over 500 ERP implementations and understands ground-level manufacturing challenges.
How fast can I see ROI after implementation?
Most manufacturers start seeing operational clarity and reduced errors within the first few months.
Why not continue using Excel?
Excel cannot provide real-time control, automation, or process integration required for manufacturing.
Can Ease Margin replace Tally?
Ease Margin complements or replaces Tally by handling manufacturing operations, while accounting remains integrated.
How is Ease Margin different from traditional ERP software?
Traditional ERPs are heavy and complex, while Ease Margin is simple, fast to implement, and manufacturing-focused.
What stage is Ease Margin currently at?
Ease Margin is a Seed stage SaaS product focused on rapid customer acquisition.
What is Ease Margin’s growth expectation?
Ease Margin expects its customer base to grow 3x year over year.
How does Ease Margin plan to scale?
Ease Margin plans to scale by standardizing implementation, expanding the team, and improving automation.
What is Ease Margin’s pricing strategy?
Ease Margin follows a simple annual subscription model priced at ₹799 per user per month.
What does Ease Margin believe in?
Ease Margin believes software should simplify manufacturing, not complicate it.
Why was Ease Margin built?
Ease Margin was built after seeing manufacturers struggle with complex systems that don’t match ground reality.
Can Ease Margin handle GST-compliant documents?
Yes, Ease Margin supports GST-compliant invoicing and documentation.
Can Ease Margin handle multiple price lists?
Yes, pricing can be managed flexibly based on customer and transaction type.
What happens if internet is slow?
Ease Margin is optimized for low-bandwidth environments commonly found in factories.
My stock is always mismatching. I don’t know what is correct.
This usually happens when stock is managed in Excel or registers. Ease Margin gives you real-time inventory with FIFO logic, so inward, outward, and balance are always accurate.
We are using Excel and it works fine for us.
Excel works initially, but as transactions increase it causes errors, duplication, and no real-time visibility. Ease Margin automates this and gives you clarity without extra effort.
ERP software is very complex. My team won’t use it.
That’s a common concern. Ease Margin is designed to be simple and practical, and we provide step-by-step training during implementation.
How will I know my actual profit?
Ease Margin links FIFO cost with sales price, so you can see accurate margins for every sale.
Implementation sounds time-consuming.
Implementation takes 2 weeks, but it’s structured into short sessions so daily work is not disturbed.
Can this work for my small factory?
Yes, Ease Margin scales from small factories to growing manufacturers. You can start simple and expand as you grow.
My process is different from others.
Ease Margin supports custom fields and flexible workflows to match unique manufacturing processes.
I want to check business numbers on mobile.
Ease Margin’s mobile app lets you track inventory, sales, and reports anytime, anywhere.
What if my internet is slow?
Ease Margin is optimized for low-bandwidth factory environments common in India.
Why should I pay ₹799/user/month?
The cost is recovered through reduced errors, time savings, and better margin control within months.
